architecture.fixtures: Lake, Orange, Osceola, Polk, and Seminole are complete ≥5.0 acre extracts in 0.25° tiles under data/fixtures/orlando-parcels/tiles/{fips}/. Brevard, Marion, Sumter, and Volusia remain single-file samples.
architecture.runtime: GET /api/parcels?market=Orlando&bbox=w,s,e,n reads only tiles that intersect the viewport. Optional source=live queries DOH for a zoomed-in sample county, still at ≥5 acres.
architecture.acreageRule: Include when FDOR LND_SQFOOT >= 217800 (5.0 acres). Orange OCPA ACREAGE replaces the stored value when it is also >= 5.

primaryStack.name: Florida DOH EHWATER parcels (FDOR NAL attributes)
primaryStack.notes: Official public GIS joined to Florida DOR Name-Address-Legal tax-roll attributes. No zoning polygons. Acreage derived from LND_SQFOOT when present.

fieldMapping.zoning: null on DOH layer — degrade gracefully
fieldMapping.flu: null except Orange County OCPA pilot join

counties.name: Brevard

alternateSources.name: Brevard County Property Appraiser MapServer
alternateSources.notes: Official parcel layer exists but returned HTTP 403 here; DOH layer used instead.

gaps: BCPAO live endpoint may require allowlisted clients

counties.name: Lake

alternateSources.name: Lake County Open Data Tax Parcels
alternateSources.notes: Richer owner/sale fields; seed prefers DOH for shed-wide consistency.

gaps: Complete ≥5 acre geometry and FDOR owner/sale/tax. No zoning or FLU on the DOH extract.
OZ 2.0 join is the seven-market rural-eligible pack only.

counties.name: Marion

alternateSources.name: Marion County ParcelsAndSubdivisions
alternateSources.notes: Includes ZONE1/ZONE2/ZONE3; not wired into seed yet.

gaps: Zoning is available on the county MapServer but is not joined in this thinner sample

counties.name: Orange

alternateSources.name: DOH EHWATER Orange
alternateSources.notes: Used for live viewport fills; OCPA remaining the zoning/FLU-rich pilot fixture.

gaps: Universe is DOH LND_SQFOOT ≥ 5 acres. OCPA zoning, owner, sale, and tax join when PARCEL matches.
Municipal FLU besides Orlando is often the county placeholder City and stays unknown.
Income and AADT are not joined on the full extract.

counties.name: Osceola

alternateSources.name: City of St Cloud Referenced Parcels
alternateSources.notes: Has Zone1/sale/owner but is St Cloud–centric, not full county.

gaps: Complete ≥5 acre geometry and FDOR owner/sale/tax. No county-wide zoning layer is joined.
St Cloud city parcels are not a substitute for the county extract.

counties.name: Polk

alternateSources.name: ArcGIS Online Polk_County_Parcels
alternateSources.notes: Public AGOL item labeled Polk but geometries land in Minnesota (~45°N). Do not use.

gaps: Complete ≥5 acre geometry and FDOR owner/sale/tax. No zoning on the DOH extract.
The AGOL layer labeled Polk County parcels is in Minnesota and is not used.

counties.name: Seminole
